title: Steam Workshop Inspection and Maintenance Corner
description: One static steam-workshop inspection and maintenance-themed scene: an unchanged full cutaway piston display stands on its own broad ground base in the west equipment bay. A perpendicular complete worktable in the east carries a whole fixed gear study kit, while a separate freestanding rack stages its original hammer, mallet and chisel. Four unchanged asset IDs and four unit-scale instances preserve every original mesh, hierarchy, oriented triangle and full solid PBR. One closed scene-only floor supports the three grounded assemblies; the entire gear-kit base rests on the actual finite table top. Six connected finite empty reference volumes distinguish the front cross passage, central aisle, piston front and rear inspection sides, sample bench and tool rack. One scene and zero new independent models. The piston is not placed on an undersized bench. No pipes, boiler, drivetrain, power connection, animation, tool cabinet or repair sequence is added. Static game visual only; no actual maintenance, pressure, steam, heat, force transmission, gear motion, tool operation, compatibility, engineering, ergonomics, accessibility, navigation, load, stability, manufacture, installation or safety certification.
